item.description:

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang posted on X that “AGI has arrived,” in response to the release of OpenAI’s latest model, a reference to artificial intelligence that is more capable than humans.

item.title: Saint-Gobain appoints Annica Hagen as Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer and accelerates AI deployment
item.description:
# Saint-Gobain appoints Annica Hagen as Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer and accelerates AI deployment 09/07/2026
![Annica Hagen](https://www.saint-gobain.com/sites/saint-gobain.com/files/styles/wysiwyg_halfwidth/public/media/image/2026-09/Annica-Hagen.jpg?itok=TsrfE1Xr)
Annica Hagen has been appointed Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO) and member of the Group Executive Committee, effective September 1, 2026.
In this newly created role, Annica Hagen will lead the Group’s AI ambitions in support of the strategic objectives of “Lead & Grow”.
She will oversee the structuring, prioritization and scaling up of existing local AI initiatives across countries and businesses.
This appointment illustrates Saint-Gobain’s ambition to position AI as a strategic enabler to accelerate sustainable growth, enhance innovation, optimize operations and improve value creation for customers, in line with the “Lead & Grow” priorities.
Its integrated and innovative solutions provide sustainability, performance and well-being for its customers.
